description: Search the text of Ofsted inspection reports by topic (for example SEND support, bullying, early reading) and return matching passages quoted from the reports, each with the school and a link to the page of the report PDF. Needs an area: schools near a postcode, a local authority, or one school. Can also be limited to a phase.

include_earlier_reports.description: Include earlier reports as well as each school's latest

local_authority.description: Only schools in this local authority (name or code)

phase.description: all, nursery, primary, secondary or sixteen_plus (default all)

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, such as support for pupils with dyslexia

radius_km.description: Distance from the postcode in kilometres, 0.5 to 30 (default 5)

name: search_inspection_reports
